title: The Labyrinth Spiral Route
statement:
An underground chamber is mapped as an R x C grid of treasure chests. An explorer must traverse all cells starting from top-left (0,0) in clockwise spiral order (right, down, left, up).

Given an R x C matrix, print all elements in clockwise spiral traversal order.
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers R and C.
Next R lines: C space-separated integers per line.
outputFormat: Print the elements in spiral order separated by spaces.

sampleCases.explanation: Spiral path visiting outer border then center.
